title: 2026 Season Power Rankings
subtitle: Post–Week 3 board, with Goats alone at 3-0, a 299 kitty from the Slumlords and Muff off the Survivor bus. Waivers have cleared, and this is the whole picture, not just points for.
method: W/L + win quality + roster ceiling + FAAB + pedigree + sit/start + trades; PF is evidence, not the ranking.

rankings.blurb: Juice: the league’s only 3-0, and they did it the grown-up way. Kittle’s 32 and Henry’s 24 turned Morningside into a 219–144 formality, the PA (616.5) says nobody has laid a glove on them, and $81 FAAB is still in the holster after a quiet $3 Metellus add. Junk: Josh Jacobs sits on the Commissioner Exempt list, and 219 was the lowest winning score of the week. Ultron at home is a soft landing. Enjoy the view while it lasts.

Juice: the Host keeps winning the IDP math olympiad. A 98.5-point offense still closed 256.5 because the defense printed 158, the season PF (795.5) is second in WU country, there’s already a 322.5 kitty on the shelf, and $111 is the fattest FAAB wallet in the league. Junk: Waddle’s 6 and Kincaid’s 3.5 were a quiet encore after the TE party, and waivers brought two $0 fliers (Coleman, C. Johnson) instead of a real swing. Doubtpfizer comes to town next with CMC and something to prove.

Juice: Rymo’s SPD’s ended Saltese’s perfect start with a WR/TE crime spree. Juwan Johnson went for 30.5, Golden 27, Adams 26 and Higgins 21, stacked into a 142.5 offense and a 263.5 final. They sit at 2-1 with $105 FAAB and just added Jake Hansen for $5. Junk: A.J. Brown is on IR, so the skill room that just carried them has to do it one man short. A road trip to 0-3 Drummond is the easiest dinner on the Week 4 menu.

Juice: still 2-1 with 769 PF (third in the league), and JSN leads the OMVP board at 126 after another 40. Stafford’s 25 kept the ceiling honest. Junk: the rookie franchise took its first scar at SPD’s, Oronde Gadsden posted a zero in a starting slot, and the injury report is ugly. Breece Hall is Doubtful, Dowdle is Q and unlikely, and Parsons is still on PUP. FAAB is down to $26 after a $0 Herbig pickup. Muff at home is a chance to steady the ship.

Juice: Jesse’s LAB handed TTAB its first L with an adult RB day. Warren went for 27, Jeremiyah Love 24 and Kyren 23, and the defense added 135 for a 239.5 close. They shook off getting IDP-heisted by Ultron in Week 2, climbed to 2-1, and spent $26 on Jaylen Wright to deepen the backfield, with $67 left. Junk: Jayden Daniels, Puka and Mike Evans are all Q, Shakir scored 1 on the winning side, and 670.5 PF is middle of the pack. Hyper (league-high PF) is coming to town.

Juice: the league-high PF (813) and a 281.5 in Week 3 that would have beaten every other team on the board. Sadiq’s 34.5 and Walker’s 23 were real, and $72 FAAB bought Darren Waller for $6. Junk: 1-2 anyway, with the second-highest PA in WU country (824.5) and a quality-loss collection that’s turning into a museum. Fantrax lists Nick Bosa as out indefinitely. We’re ranking the roster, not the record, but the record is starting to argue back.

Juice: 2-1 with the league’s lowest PA (573.5), and a Week 1 kitty (315) that still hangs on the wall. Junk: 192 at LAB, with Josh Allen at 15 (two picks and a fumble) and a 90-point defense. The lineup call of the week is also here: Allen is Q with a knee bruise and expected to play, but Fantrax has him parked in an IR slot and no QB starting right now. Goedert is Doubtful (MCL), Doubs got dropped, and waivers brought zero claims, only free-agent adds (Hollins, Chubb, Starks, Cisco). Fix the QB slot before Substation, or that 2-1 turns into a coin flip.

Juice: a 299 kitty from a team that opened 0-2 and already rode the Survivor bus. Gibbs 42, Fannin 29 and Cook 27 did the damage, the IDP unit went for a league-bully 176, and Last Ride is still breathing. Junk: Drake Maye scored 1 in a starting slot, the 919 PA is a statistical hate crime, Pacheco is on IR, and 1-2 is still 1-2. Marcus Harris came in for $4 ($68 left). A trip to Eagle Ridge is the week’s grudge match.

Juice: first W of 2026, and it came the IDP way. Bowers went for 41.5, Fred Warner matched him with 41, Garrett Wilson added 32, and the defense choir (Leonard Williams, Jordyn Brooks, Evan Williams) finished a 263.5 over Drummond. PF is fourth in the league at 756, and $79 FAAB is still in the bank after grabbing Brian Robinson Jr. and Trenton Simpson for $6 each. Junk: Etienne is OUT with a hamstring, Coker and Julian Love are Q, and 1-2 means no more quality-loss excuses. Slumlords and their 299 are coming to town.

Juice: still 2-1 on paper, and Tim went all-in on the RB reload with Ollie Gordon for $65 (the biggest splash of the week), plus Raheim Sanders, A.J. Dillon and Roman Wilson. Deebo’s 28 and Lamar’s 24 were lighthouses. Junk: 144 was the league floor, with Achane at 1, Jefferson 5 and Jadarian Price at minus 1, and it got them kicked off the Survivor bus. Achane is gone, Jordan Mason is on IR, Jefferson is Q with an ankle, PF (617.5) is the second-lowest in the league and FAAB is down to $42. The standings are lying on their behalf.

Juice: the dual-era champ remembered how to win ugly. CMC went for 23, Dak 20, and a 157-point IDP unit beat Ultron 265–240 to climb off the schneid. They’re tied for second-most FAAB at $105 after Kain Medrano ($4) and Reed Blankenship ($0). Junk: Jayden Reed is headed to IR, possibly for the season, Nico Collins is Q, and 1-2 with 759.5 PA leaves no margin. Next up is a road trip to the Host’s IDP factory.

Juice: Michael Wilson went for 25, Chase 24 and McLaurin 19, so the skill core isn’t the problem, and the Week 2 IDP heist over LAB still counts. Junk: 240 lost to Doubtpfizer, Terrance Ferguson scored 2 and is now Doubtful, Caleb Williams is Doubtful, and Bryce Young is getting leg imaging (expected to play). $1 of FAAB left after a Tyler Higbee buy means the fix has to come from the bench. A road trip to the league’s only 3-0 team is next.

Juice: Purdy threw 44 and London caught 36, and Nate went shopping. Izien $17, Buckner $13, Keenan Allen $13 and Trader $9 made them the week’s biggest spenders, and they cleared the whole trade block. Junk: a 91-point IDP floor lost to Pocket anyway, 583.5 PF is dead last, and $30 FAAB is all that’s left. The waiver haul was about fixing that defense, and TTAB’s QB-slot mess next week is the perfect first test.

Juice: Bijan’s 44, Burrow’s 27 and Olave’s 25 are a skill stack that should buy wins, and $45 FAAB plus some DB shuffling says Gavin is still trying (Ezeiruaku came in for $0). Junk: 0-3, 224 at Eagle Ridge, and Last Ride math (Slumlords 299 vs Dongers 224) ended the Survivor re-entry for good. SPD’s come to town fresh off a 263.5. The skill guys need an IDP unit that shows up.

week3Matchups: Indian Trail Slumlords 299, The Hypersecretors 281.5 (kitty; the quality L of the year)
Eagle Ridge Eddies 263.5, Drummond Dongers 224 (Dongers out on Last Ride)
Newman Lake Sleep Paralysis Demons 263.5, Saltese Slamm 235 (Saltese’s first L)
Little Ass Boys 239.5, Towner Top Aga Bottom 192 (TTAB’s first L)
Valley Old Goats 219, Morningside Muff Divers 144 (Survivor floor)
